text: I am capable of achieving my goals
I choose to focus on what I can control
I am worthy of success and happiness
I trust in my ability to overcome challenges
I am grateful for the opportunities in my life
I refuse to let anyone make me doubt myself
I am becoming the person I want to be
I deserve to take care of myself
I am confident, capable, and ready to embrace all the opportunities that come my way
I am worthy of love, respect, and all the good things life has to offer
